data.name: SCP: Broken God
data.detailed_description:
SCP: Broken God is a story set in the SCP Universe. You play as a member of the Foundation who has recently transferred to a new facility. During a routine day of work, an incursion occurs, carefully planned out and strategically executed by a religious cult known as the Church of the Broken God. Your role is one of a survivor, aiming to escape the breached facility or attempting to stop the cult.

GAMEPLAY
We wish to push the player on the choice to approach each situation with caution, combining both action and stealth, with the core of a classic survival horror game. Each situation you find yourself in has its own unique and interesting gameplay mechanics to constantly keep you on edge. The game is stylised towards a more retro aesthetic.

SURVIVAL HORROR
The game features some action-leaning elements and cutscenes to enhance story-led elements. Scares of many different kinds for those looking for the classic horror thrill, unique enemy behaviours for those looking for interesting ways to approach situations, and multiple endings, all influenced by your decisions in various scenarios and interactions.

SCP
Of course, there are many SCPs, including some classics; SCP-096, SCP-173, SCP-939, SCP-106 and the arsenal of the Church of the Broken God, all with a refreshing re-interpretation for a deepened horror experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (v1703+)
  • Processor: Intel/AMD quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU (2 GB VRAM minimum)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit (v20H2+)
  • Processor: Intel/AMD 6-core 2.8 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible stereo

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Sonoma 14.0
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 or Intel quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 1.2 compatible (integrated ok)
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Sonoma 14.x or Ventura 13.5+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M2 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 3 compatible with 4 GB dedicated VRAM
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / Rocky Linux 8
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel/AMD 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050+ or AMD equivalent with Vulkan support
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio compatible
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
  • Processor: 6-core Intel/AMD 3.0 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060+ or AMD RX 5700 XT
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio compatible
